body: Do not designate InvocationId as the complete authority: it is caller-supplied and cannot distinguish two otherwise identical accounts with different target members. I approve one narrow public derivation seam, with a type-discipline correction: OutputTargetIdentity[Id] must be invariant, not contravariant, and must expose canonical bytes/parts derived from Id rather than accept or return a caller-supplied per-value Checksum. The library computes the domain-separated checksum itself. Provide the exact library-owned String instance over UTF-8; do not use toString or a generic JSON Encoder. ReportInputIdentity must bind ordered universe-member identities and ordered TargetAccount identities, plus the existing universe definition/size/dispositions/payloads, and contextual decode must rederive it. Reject an account if unequal in-scope target ids collapse to one derived target identity. Courts required: same invocation/source/build with only one String target changed changes the report identity; reorder where order is meaningful changes it; a collapsing test instance is refused; a foreign report receipt differing only in target id is refused; and an Id without an explicit instance does not compile. No new module or wider context bounds. This is explicit vocabulary approval for that seam only.
